finalText:
All application call sites are migrated. The 11 files under `packages/*` now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

The one remaining `db.query` call is in `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`, which its header comment says is a vendored third-party copy that's overwritten wholesale on every upgrade — local edits there would be silently lost, so I left it as-is. Worth flagging separately if that dependency needs its own upgrade to drop `db.query`.
